description: This file defines a Java class 'SensorGauge' that provides GUI components and functionality for creating and managing sensor gauges in a UI, including interactions like double-click and right-click to detach or change gauges.

classes.name: SensorGauge
classes.description: A class providing methods to create and manage sensor gauges in a GUI, including event handling and customization.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge component for a given sensor with associated listener and optional menu item.

methods.name: createGaugeBody
methods.description: Constructs the visual gauge and sets up sensor updates and mouse interactions.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays a context menu for changing or detaching gauges.

methods.name: fillGaugeMenuItems
methods.description: Populates the popup menu with categories and sensor options.

methods.name: handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click events on gauges to detach the sensor display.

methods.name: createRadial
methods.description: Creates and configures a radial gauge component.
